title: fix(app-shell): an object list page reads its object once per load
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9S4kudqKDVAkUeevg4EXJ6t)_

Fixes #34207

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：对象列表页加载时不再额外发 `GET data/对象?top=0` 计数探测，每次加载只发列表自己那一次读，刷新也只发一次。
- 为什么改：探测拿到的数字已经没有任何地方显示（原分屏页脚已退役，唯一还接收它的 ViewConfigPanel 属性从不读取）；页脚计数栏和标题里的视图计数本来就取列表回答里的 `total`。多一次请求只是加重托管环境的首屏负担（cloud#4563）。
- 风险与回滚：低。页面上显示的数字不变；只删了一个副作用和一个无人读取的状态。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewLiveData.ts`（删掉的探测 effect）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`（删掉 `recordCount` 状态与传参）、`ObjectView.recordCountFooter-10636.test.tsx` 末尾新 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.recordCountFooter-10636.test.tsx -t 34207`，预期 2 条全绿（加载只读一次、刷新只读一次且计数栏跟随新 total）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `useObjectViewLiveData` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewLiveData.ts`) no longer sends `dataSource.find(object, { $top: 0 })` on mount and on every `refreshKey` bump. Its `dataSource`, `refreshKey` and `setRecordCount` inputs go with it; the realtime refresh and conflict resolution are unchanged.
- `ObjectView.tsx` drops the page-level `recordCount` state and the `recordCount={recordCount}` it passed to `ViewConfigPanel`.

Why removal and not repointing (the seat asked to measure what the footer counts before changing the number):

- The probe asked the object's UNFILTERED total. Its only sink was `recordCount`, and on `dfb8ed35` that state reached exactly one place: `ViewConfigPanel`'s `recordCount` prop, which the component never destructures or reads (`ViewConfigPanel.tsx` declares it at the props interface and its function signature omits it). The split-pane footer it once fed (`record-count-footer`) was retired by #28915; `ObjectView.recordCountFooter-10636.test.tsx` already asserts that testid is absent.
- What the page draws: `ListView`'s `record-count-bar` (`list.recordCount` with `serverTotal ?? data.length`, `serverTotal` = the list answer's `total` under pagination) and the title's view count (`viewTotal`, set by `handleListTotalChange` from the list's own answer). Both mean "rows in this view" and both already come from the list query, which carries the view's filters and search. So the grid already publishes its own answer's total up to the page; no hand-off had to be added and `plugin-grid` / `plugin-list` are untouched (no `ObjectGrid.tsx` edit).
- Refresh: create / delete / realtime / external bumps still re-read through `ListView`'s `refreshTrigger` and the data-invalidation bus, and the bar follows the new answer (pinned below).

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in `ObjectView.recordCountFooter-10636.test.tsx` (the file's existing harness), a real `ObjectView` + `ListView` mount with a spied `dataSource.find`. Each answer carries 3 rows and a larger `total`, and a `$top: 0` call would answer `total: 999`:

- load: zero `$top: 0` calls, exactly one `find` for the object, bar reads `42 records`;
- refresh (`externalRefreshKey` bump, which sums into `refreshKey`): exactly one more read, no probe, bar follows to `43 records`.

Forced test edits:

- `ObjectView.externalRefreshSum-10572.test.tsx`: two cases asserted the probe re-read once per external bump (`countQueries - count` = 1). They now assert 0, the case titles and docblock say why; the list-read assertions are unchanged.
- `ObjectView.recordCountFooter-10636.test.tsx`: one docblock sentence said the count came from the `$top: 0` query; it now names the list answer.

Ablation (fix committed first; both files restored from `dfb8ed35` with `git restore --source`, probe line count 1 and `setRecordCount` count 2 confirmed on disk, then `git checkout HEAD --` and `git diff HEAD` empty, blob hashes equal HEAD): both new cases red, `a $top: 0 count probe was sent: expected [ [ 'duly_task', { '$top': +0 } ] ] to deeply equal []` and `one refresh, one read: expected 2 to be 1`. ui vitest resolves `@object-ui/*` to `src/` through `ui/vitest.config.mts`, so no build sat between mutation and run.

## Acceptance notes

- The seat's CONTROL "an answer without `total` shows no count" was written for the probe-fed number. That number is drawn nowhere, so there is no control to keep on it. The bar's no-`total` behaviour belongs to `ListView` (`serverTotal ?? data.length`) and is untouched here; not pinned in this PR.
- `ViewConfigPanel`'s `recordCount?: number` prop ("Optional record count to display") is declared and never read. It is an exported component's prop, so removing it is outside this card's surface; noted, not filed (dead code, no runtime reach).
- Nine ObjectView / PageView test files still filter `$top !== 0` out of their list-read counts. With no probe the filter is a no-op and they stay green (run below); their comments naming the probe are now stale. Left as they are to keep the diff on the card's surface.
- Live HTTP count on a built Console: NOT MEASURED (the jsdom pin counts `dataSource.find` on the real page; the card's reading was taken over HTTP on 18.5.0).

## Verification

<details><summary>Local runs at the final head</summary>

- `pnpm exec vitest run` on the two touched test files at `20e8b3ac`: Test Files 2 passed, Tests 17 passed.
- At `221abdf1` (code identical to the final head; the later commit adds a module-top import in the two edited pins, re-run green at the final head): every `ObjectView*.test.tsx`, `ViewConfigPanel*.test.ts(x)` and `__tests__/PageView.refreshInPlace-10519.test.tsx` under app-shell views: Test Files 85 passed, Tests 682 passed (the full app-shell package runs in CI's Test UI shards).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` at `221abdf1`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `20e8b3ac`: 38 derived, 38 run, all exit 0; `--ran`: "38 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". The first round at `221abdf1` had `check:test-source-alias` red (the two edited pins reach a dynamic `import(@objectstack/lint)` through `ObjectView`); `20e8b3ac` adds the module-top import the gate prescribes, as sibling ObjectView pins do.

</details>
